integrity: Analytical proof and explicit finite attaining pairs supplied; a standalone exact-rational and finite nonlinear diagnostic checker is included. These computations are not independent validation.
limitations: No extension proved for general graphs, nonseparable objectives, non-strictly-convex losses with nonunique minimizers, weighted edge variation, or statistical risk. Indexed/inspected literature is not exhaustive.
scientific_scope: Real finite open paths, independent finite edge-slope intervals, positive site weights, strictly convex translation-invariant residual losses; mixed sitewise power exponents greater than one by approximation.
title: Universal path-variation contraction for heterogeneous convex slope-box regression
